hero.lead: I design and build robust, typed, scalable web platforms — from Symfony and PHP back-ends to React and Next.js front-ends. Ten years shipping products with teams across Europe and beyond.

about.statement: Ten years turning complex requirements into products that ship — and keep running.
about.body: For a decade I've worked across the full stack, with deep roots in PHP and Symfony (7+ years) and four years building front-ends in React, TypeScript and Next.js. I've partnered with international teams — Unlocked (NL), Kleap (CH), Ubiweb (CA) — as engineer, tech lead and founding team member, and I care about clean architecture, typed contracts between front and back, and shipping things that last.
